source.name: Seattle Seahawks: 'CenturyLink Field To Become Lumen Field'
source.quote: the Seahawks and Lumen announced today that the Seattle stadium will be renamed Lumen Field

note: Stadium naming rights: Lumen Field. The Lumen name took effect with the 2020-11-19 announcement, under the stadium's existing naming-rights agreement; the same article says a 2017 agreement extended the naming rights through the 2033 season, so 'to' is 2033.
